outcome: Money and Milestones tabs on the live project API
acceptance_criteria: With `/money` returning stages in a given order, the Money tab rows appear in exactly that order, with no position number — verify: `tests/money.test.tsx` renders a fixture whose keys are out of any alphabetical order and asserts the row order.
A null `amount` shows Unknown (the existing `Unknown` tag) with its `missing_reason`, and never "0", "0.00" or blank — verify: test asserts the cell text and that no `0.00` appears in the table.

A null `paid` or `owed` on an invoice shows Unknown for that figure. The page makes no "Paid" or "Part paid" word of its own. An invoice with `status: "Awaiting Finance decision"` shows that text exactly — verify: component test, plus a model test that `paid === amount` does not change any text.
No total, subtotal or sum appears anywhere. A fixture with two known stage amounts and one null shows only the individual figures — verify: test asserts no element contains the arithmetic sum.
A stage with two invoices lists both, each with its own status, paid and owed — verify: component test.
Currency comes from the item: an `USD` item shows `USD 1,000.00`, never `₦` — verify: model test.
`limited: true` shows the "Some figures may be incomplete." warning, and `limited: false` shows none; "As of" shows `as_of` — verify: component test and the `/money` page in the mock.

Pressing an amount sets `?figure=<key>`, issues `GET …/money?figure=<key>`, and the panel (phone: the sheet) lists the item's sources in order with label, kind and time. An item with no sources reads "No source recorded". An unknown key shows "That figure isn't available." and leaves the table — verify: component test with the mock server, 1440 and 390 widths.

`/money` returning 404 or 403 shows only "You can't see this project's money.", with no stage, amount or server message. A 500 shows the error card with Try again, and pressing it re-reads. A body missing `items` shows the error card and draws nothing partial — verify: tests for each, and no `ApiError` message text in the DOM.

The Milestones tab shows `contract_stage: true` items only, with due and completion text, and the CHANGES column only when a change exists. A change with `additional_amount: null` reads "change amount Unknown", and the contract amount is not combined with it — verify: component tests for `default` and for the `psl_mock_milestones=changed` cookie page.

"Recorded completions" is its own list under the table and is never merged into table rows. A second page (`has_more`) appends through "Show more" with `?page=2` — verify: test asserts the request query and the appended rows.

When `/money` is 404, the Milestones tab shows the completions and the "aren't available to your role" note, and no amount, invoice or column header — verify: test and `/projects/<id>/milestones` with the scripted persona. When `/milestones` is refused and `/money` is ok, the table shows without a completions heading. When both are refused, only the note shows.
Wrong user and wrong tenant: a project the persona cannot see (P-0099 and its UUID) answers 404 from both mock routes, and the pages show no data for it — verify: `tests/mock-live-money.test.ts`.

`tests/mock-live-money.test.ts` (new, modelled on `mock-live-projects.test.ts`) validates every money fixture and every body the mock serves for `/money`, `/money?figure=`, and `/milestones` (every persona and scenario that returns 200) against the live contract with Ajv 2020 and `addFormats`, with UUID `case_id` values, and checks that P-nnnn requests still resolve — verify: `npx vitest run tests/mock-live-money.test.ts`.

The old tests for the removed shapes (`money.test.tsx`, `money-model.test.ts`, `mock-money.test.ts`, and the milestone cases in `project-tabs*.test*` and `mock-project-tabs.test.ts`) are rewritten for the live shape with every behaviour above still asserted. None is deleted without a replacement, and no assertion is weakened — verify: `npx vitest run` passes from `frontend/`.

No `api.GET('/api/v1/reports/…')`, `E-PROJECT-TAB` or `E-REPORT` reference remains in `MoneyTab.tsx`, `MilestonesTab.tsx`, `useMoney.ts` or their models — verify: `grep -rn "E-REPORT\|E-PROJECT-TAB" src/features/projects/{Money,Milestones,money,milestones,useMoney,useMilestones}*` has no hits. `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run lint` are clean.

Live smoke (integration owner): with Django on 8010, a signed-in account that holds `finance.read` opens `/projects/<case_id>/money` and `/milestones` on port 4970, and both render without console errors, with a real `as_of`. A local account without `finance.read` (for example live-none, if it can see a project) opens `/milestones` and sees no figures. If no local project carries money data, record that and rely on criteria 1 to 16 — verify: the build.md records the account, the case and what each page showed.

Money display has no write control: no button or form submits anything from either tab, and no request other than GET leaves them — verify: component test spies on `fetch`, and asserts only GET calls.

risk.rationale: Medium. Reads only, but it replaces typed v7 mock rows with the live `/money` shapes and the sectioned milestones tab, so `moneyModel.ts` and `tabsModel.ts` must be rebuilt on display-text states. Money display is the hazard. A null amount, `paid` or `owed` rendered as 0, or a paid state worked out from the numbers, would misstate finance. That is why the surfaces include contract-change and the spec must test these cases. Product acceptance is required because the client sees changed columns, hidden fields and new "unknown" and "not available to your role" states.

findings.summary: `isInvoice` does not check `id` or `currency`, and `isChange` does not check `link_id`. All three are required by the contract. They are used as React keys, and `invoice.currency` goes into `amountText`. A body missing them would draw "undefined 1.00" or a duplicate key rather than the bad-body card. Add the integer and string checks at moneyModel.ts:19 and :27.

findings.summary: Escape does not close the phone bottom sheet. It is `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` and the close X works, but pressing Escape leaves `?figure=` in the URL and the dialog open (checked at 390 on /projects/P-0101/money?figure=kickoff). Keyboard users on a modal expect Escape. Likely in the shared sheet component, so route to whoever owns it.

The tabs have no section headings: the only heading on the page is the project h1. "Billing by contract stage" and "Recorded completions" are plain text, and the data table has no caption. Screen-reader users cannot jump to the completions list. Make them h2 and caption the table.

The Proof buttons carry no `aria-expanded` and rely on a hidden "for <name>" label to tell them apart, which is fine; the expanded state is not announced. Add `aria-expanded` to match the inline reveal.

Fidelity gate fails on every run, and there is no `delivery/features/F-71/fidelity-exceptions.json`. Expected: coverage 100% after approved exceptions, visual >= 90. Actual (P-0101, finance_lead for Money, pm for Milestones): SCR-12 desktop 1440 coverage 55.1% (27/49), visual 83.4, missing 22, moved 5, extra 11; SCR-12 mobile 390 coverage 36.4% (8/22), visual 82.0; SCR-38 desktop 1440 coverage 65.1% (28/43), visual 81.9, missing 15, moved 5; SCR-38 desktop-changed 1440 coverage 78.6%; SCR-38 mobile 390 coverage 59.1% (13/22), visual 79.1; SCR-38 mobile-changed 390 coverage 75% (3/4), visual 81.1. Frontend must list each spec-accepted hide (spec "Conflicts with the boards" 1 to 7) and the other differences below as exception proposals, and the design engineer approves them; then rerun. Visual below 90 stays blocking even then, and the table and cards need the fixes in UI-1-2 to UI-1-4 to close it.

Money tab, desktop 1440: the Paid column breaks figures in the middle ("Paid NGN / 2,000,000.00 · Owed / NGN 500,000.00"), separating the currency code from the amount and making Paid and Owed figures hard to pair. The board shows one short value per row. Keep each "<code> <amount>" unbroken (no-wrap on the figure, one "Paid ... · Owed ..." pair per line) or give the column more width. The same wrapping appears in the Milestones table PAID column (kick-off row). Path: `src/features/projects/MoneyCells.tsx`, `money.css`, `project-tabs.css`.

Money tab, desktop: before a figure is chosen the right panel is a blue header strip "Choose an amount to see where it comes from." followed by an empty bordered box. The board's panel has a header and body content. An empty body strip reads as a broken panel. Show the prompt as the panel body with no empty second box (`shots/money-limited-1440.png`). Path: `money.css`.

"Unknown" is drawn two ways: the board and the Money tab use bold brown text; the Milestones tab (desktop CONTRACT AMOUNT and PAID, and phone cards) uses a yellow filled tag. The board SCR-38 shows plain bold brown "Unknown". Use the same treatment as Money and the board. Path: `src/features/projects/MilestonesTab.tsx`, `project-tabs.css`.

Amounts read `NGN 3,000,000.00` where the boards draw `₦3,000,000`. The spec's acceptance criterion requires the currency code from the item, so this is intended, but it is a board difference and must be in the exceptions file (UI-1-1).
